content.short: Cicada Tactics is a multiplayer tactical RPG using Cardano wallets, smart contracts, and playable NFT assets.
content.description: Cicada Tactics is a multiplayer tactical RPG that demonstrates how a complete blockchain game can work on Cardano. Players can acquire Cicada assets from a smart contract store, connect with a wallet, and use those assets to log in and play with other users. The project explores concepts such as verifiable digital assets, blockchain-based authentication, smart contract commerce, and time-aware game state. Its purpose is both playable entertainment and a practical example of Cardano game infrastructure.
